PDF A null-scattering path integral formulation of light transport
By deriving the path integral formulation from the null-scattering VRE, the transmittance becomes the analytically evaluable combined transmittance ̄T . Now between two real-scattering events, there are several null-scattering events, and the product of all these events gives the pdf, as seen in the next chapter.
